title: Image-Level Regression for Uncertainty-Aware Retinal Image Segmentation (SAUNA)
mechanism: Convert hard thin-structure masks to soft targets from distance to the annotation boundary and local thickness, then train as regression with a generalised JML plus a stable Focal-L1 loss.
adaptation: Crack only: SAUNA transform of the 1-2 px crack labels, thickness term normalises source width (ARTS 1.5 px to SDLE 3.25 px); separate sigmoid crack head with GJML + SF-L1 next to the 24-class softmax trained with house CE; crack threshold re-picked on val. BMRK (downscaled ELPV) is the aliasing case where the paper's evidence is strongest.
min_experiment: Arm: SAUNA crack targets + GJML + SF-L1, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Metric crack IoU at val-chosen threshold, relP@2, relR@2, BMRK crack IoU. Kill: crack IoU < SUP100 + 0.012 or relP@2 drop > 0.05.
evidence: R: FIVES, low-res input, UNet++ BCE+Dice hard 74.05 IoU; JML+BLS 81.77; SAUNA+GJML+SF-L1 84.75; UNet++ high-res hard 81.70. +0.4 to +2.3 IoU over BLS on STARE, DRIVE, CHASEDB1, HRF.
prior_overlap: none: soft-label regression targets never run; offset-tolerant CE and Skeleton Recall are different mechanisms.
